description: FACEIT Anti-Cheat. Kernel-level security client required for competitive matchmaking on FACEIT.
notes: FACEIT Anti-Cheat requires administrator privileges to install and uninstall (e.g. 'sudo scoop install faceit-ac').
IMPORTANT: Launch 'FACEIT AC' from the Start Menu, wait for it to update, and restart your computer before playing.
Connecting to FACEIT servers requires UEFI Boot Mode, Secure Boot enabled, TPM 2.0, CPU Virtualization (VT-x/AMD-V), and VBS / Core Isolation.

script: error 'Administrator privileges are required to install FACEIT Anti-Cheat. Please run Scoop with sudo (e.g. `sudo scoop install faceit-ac`) or from an elevated PowerShell prompt.'

post_install: warn 'Please launch FACEIT AC from the Start Menu, wait for it to finish updating, and restart your computer before playing.'

script: error 'Administrator privileges are required to uninstall FACEIT Anti-Cheat. Please run Scoop from an elevated PowerShell prompt.'
